content_sections.text: Starting Date for Apply Online: 01-09-2026 Last Date for Apply Online: 13-09-2026 up to 12:00 Noon

content_sections.heading: CCS HAU Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: CCS HAU has announced 377 vacancies for apprentices in 25 ITI trades. The trade-wise vacancy details are given below:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for CCS HAU Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates who have completed the required ITI qualification in the relevant trade can apply for CCS HAU Apprentice Recruitment 2026. Candidates are required to upload their Matric certificate and original ITI pass certificate with marks while submitting the application. Educational Qualification: Matric / 10th and ITI Pass in the relevant trade. Trade Qualification: Candidates should possess the ITI qualification applicable to the apprentice trade for which they are applying. Apprenticeship Profile: Candidates must complete their apprenticeship profile 100% before submitting the application.

content_sections.heading: CCS HAU Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection of candidates for CCS HAU Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be made purely on merit. No written examination has been mentioned in the notification. Merit will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the ITI marksheet. Eligible candidates will be selected according to their ITI marks.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for CCS HAU Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready while submitting the online application: Recent Photograph Aadhaar Number Identity Proof - Voter ID / Driving Licence / Passport Matriculation Certificate Original ITI Pass Certificate issued by the ITI Department ITI Marks / Marksheet Candidates must ensure that their apprenticeship profile is 100% complete. There is no requirement to submit a hard copy of the application to the university office.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CCS HAU Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the Apprenticeship India portal. Complete the candidate registration process if you are not already registered. Login using your registered details. Complete your apprenticeship profile 100%. Search for the CCS HAU Hisar apprenticeship opportunity. Select the relevant ITI apprentice trade. Fill in the required application details carefully. Upload your photograph, Aadhaar details, valid ID proof, Matric certificate and ITI pass certificate with marks. Submit the online application on or before 13 September 2026 up to 12:00 noon. Keep a copy of the submitted application for future reference.
